name: Service trust constrained by aws:SourceArn - confused-deputy constraint, still informational
note: IAM-805 (service confused-deputy constraint). A service principal (s3.amazonaws.com) trust further pinned with aws:SourceArn is the recommended confused-deputy mitigation for service trust. It remains a normal service relationship (informational) and never an external/escalation finding.
rationale: aws:SourceArn compares the ARN of the resource that caused a service to make the call and is available when the call is made directly by an AWS service principal. Used in a service-principal trust it is the documented confused-deputy mitigation - a CONSTRAINT that ties the assume to a specific source resource. This is a normal, well-hardened service-role relationship: it stays informational (TRUST-SERVICE) and must never be elevated to an external-account, public, or escalation finding, nor licence any inference about the assumed role's permissions (out of scope / unknown). Ref: AWS global condition key aws:SourceArn; docs/trust-policy-semantics.md sec 4.3 and 5 (service trust = informational).
